Summary.en: Embeds a local-AI chat widget into the tagged container (requires a configured LLAMA server).
Summary.de: Bettet ein Chat-Widget der lokalen KI in den markierten Container ein (erfordert einen konfigurierten LLAMA-Server).
Summary.it: Integra un widget di chat dell'IA locale nel contenitore contrassegnato (richiede un server LLAMA configurato).

Parameter.MaxPages: Maximum number of PDF pages to process (default: 5). Set to 0 for no limit.
Parameter.Rotation: Image rotation in degrees (90, 180 or 270). 0 or unset means the rotation is unknown.
Parameter.MaxPixelSize: Maximum total pixel budget (width x height). Larger images are downscaled client-side preserving aspect ratio. Default: 3211264. Set to 0 to disable downscaling.
Parameter.LLAMAbubble: Background color for the Llama (AI) chat bubbles (default: #e5e5ea).
Parameter.UserBubble: Background color for the user chat bubbles (default: #0b93f6).
Parameter.WelcomeText: Text shown after the model name(s) in the ready message (default: 'Chat ready. Attach file(s) and type your question.').
Parameter.WaitingText: Text shown while waiting for the AI server to become available (default: 'Waiting for AI server...').
Parameter.LowConfidenceText: Warning text shown when the AI response has low confidence (default: 'Low Confidence').
Parameter.RethinkButtonText: Button label offering to re-answer with the thinking model (default: 'Rethink').
Parameter.UncertainText: Tooltip text shown when hovering over uncertain (low-confidence) tokens (default: 'Low confidence').
Parameter.ShowUncertainTokens: Whether to visually highlight uncertain tokens in AI responses. Set to 'false' to disable highlighting (default: 'true').
Parameter.VoiceHotkey: Keyboard shortcut to toggle voice input, e.g. 'Alt+A' (default: 'Alt+A'). Format: modifier(s) + key separated by '+'.
Parameter.VoicePlaceholder: Placeholder text shown in the chat input when voice input is available (default: 'Alt+A = mic on/off | Alt+Q = mic off + send').
Parameter.VoiceSendHotkey: Keyboard shortcut to stop recording and send, e.g. 'Alt+Q' (default: 'Alt+Q').
Parameter.Language: Language code for Whisper speech-to-text (e.g. 'de', 'en'). Empty or unset means auto-detect.
Parameter.ResponseLanguage: Two-letter ISO 639-1 code (e.g. 'de', 'fr'). When set, the AI is forced to respond in this language.
Parameter.Specialist: Name of a specialist model registered via an AI_LLAMA_STD_SPECIALIST_XXX plugin property. Routes requests to that specialist's server.
Parameter.QueueBadge: If set to 'true', shows a badge with the current queue position while waiting for inference.
Parameter.QueueText: Text appended after the queue position number in the badge (e.g. 'in queue' shows '3 in queue'). Default: empty.
Parameter.AlertOnFinishText: Text shown in the alert when inference finishes (when the alert-on-finish option is enabled).
Parameter.FilterResults: If set to 'true', enables PII filtering on Brave Search queries for this instance.

MaxPages.description: Maximum number of PDF pages to process (default: 5). Set to 0 for no limit.
MaxPages.descriptionDe: Maximale Anzahl zu verarbeitender PDF-Seiten (Standard: 5). 0 deaktiviert das Limit.
MaxPages.descriptionIt: Numero massimo di pagine PDF da elaborare (predefinito: 5). 0 disabilita il limite.

Rotation.description: Image rotation in degrees (90, 180 or 270). 0 or unset means the rotation is unknown.
Rotation.descriptionDe: Bilddrehung in Grad (90, 180 oder 270). 0 oder leer bedeutet, dass die Drehung unbekannt ist.
Rotation.descriptionIt: Rotazione immagine in gradi (90, 180 o 270). 0 o vuoto indica rotazione sconosciuta.

MaxPixelSize.description: Maximum total pixel budget (width x height). Larger images are downscaled client-side preserving aspect ratio. Default: 3211264. Set to 0 to disable downscaling.
MaxPixelSize.descriptionDe: Maximales Gesamtpixelbudget (Breite × Höhe). Größere Bilder werden clientseitig unter Beibehaltung des Seitenverhältnisses verkleinert. Standard: 3211264. 0 deaktiviert die Verkleinerung.
MaxPixelSize.descriptionIt: Budget pixel totale massimo (larghezza × altezza). Le immagini più grandi vengono ridimensionate lato client mantenendo le proporzioni. Predefinito: 3211264. 0 disabilita il ridimensionamento.

LLAMAbubble.description: Background color for the Llama (AI) chat bubbles (default: #e5e5ea).
LLAMAbubble.descriptionIt: Colore di sfondo per le bolle chat Llama (AI) (predefinito: #e5e5ea).

UserBubble.description: Background color for the user chat bubbles (default: #0b93f6).
UserBubble.descriptionDe: Hintergrundfarbe für die Chatblasen des Benutzers (Standard: #0b93f6).
UserBubble.descriptionIt: Colore di sfondo per le bolle chat dell'utente (predefinito: #0b93f6).

WelcomeText.description: Text shown after the model name(s) in the ready message (default: 'Chat ready. Attach file(s) and type your question.').
WelcomeText.descriptionDe: Text nach dem/dem Modellnamen in der Bereitschaftsnachricht (Standard: 'Chat bereit. Datei(en) anhängen und Frage eingeben.').
WelcomeText.descriptionIt: Testo mostrato dopo i nomi dei modelli nel messaggio di pronto (predefinito: 'Chat pronta. Allega file e digita la tua domanda.').

WaitingText.description: Text shown while waiting for the AI server to become available (default: 'Waiting for AI server...').
WaitingText.descriptionDe: Text, der angezeigt wird, während auf den KI-Server gewartet wird (Standard: 'Warte auf KI-Server...').
WaitingText.descriptionIt: Testo mostrato mentre si attende che il server AI sia disponibile (predefinito: 'Attendere il server AI...').

LowConfidenceText.description: Warning text shown when the AI response has low confidence (default: 'Low Confidence').
LowConfidenceText.descriptionDe: Warntext, der angezeigt wird, wenn die KI-Antwort eine geringe Sicherheit hat (Standard: 'Geringe Sicherheit').
LowConfidenceText.descriptionIt: Testo di avviso mostrato quando la risposta AI ha bassa confidenza (predefinito: 'Confidenza bassa').

RethinkButtonText.description: Button label offering to re-answer with the thinking model (default: 'Rethink').
RethinkButtonText.descriptionDe: Button-Label, das anbietet, mit dem Denkmodell erneut zu antworten (Standard: 'Neu denken').
RethinkButtonText.descriptionIt: Etichetta del pulsante per rispondere nuovamente con il modello di ragionamento (predefinito: 'Riprova').

UncertainText.description: Tooltip text shown when hovering over uncertain (low-confidence) tokens (default: 'Low confidence').
UncertainText.descriptionDe: Tooltip-Text beim Überfahren unsicherer (niedrig-sicherer) Token (Standard: 'Geringe Sicherheit').
UncertainText.descriptionIt: Testo del tooltip al passaggio del mouse sui token incerti (bassa confidenza) (predefinito: 'Confidenza bassa').

ShowUncertainTokens.description: Whether to visually highlight uncertain tokens in AI responses. Set to 'false' to disable highlighting (default: 'true').
ShowUncertainTokens.descriptionDe: Ob unsichere Token in KI-Antworten visuell hervorgehoben werden sollen. 'false' deaktiviert die Hervorhebung (Standard: 'true').
ShowUncertainTokens.descriptionIt: Se evidenziare visivamente i token incerti nelle risposte AI. 'false' disabilita l'evidenziazione (predefinito: 'true').

VoiceHotkey.description: Keyboard shortcut to toggle voice input, e.g. 'Alt+A' (default: 'Alt+A'). Format: modifier(s) + key separated by '+'.
VoiceHotkey.descriptionDe: Tastenkürzel zum Umschalten der Spracheingabe, z. B. 'Alt+A' (Standard: 'Alt+A'). Format: Modifikator(en) + Taste, getrennt durch '+'.
VoiceHotkey.descriptionIt: Scorciatoia da tastiera per attivare l'input vocale, es. 'Alt+A' (predefinito: 'Alt+A'). Formato: modificatore/i + tasto separati da '+'.

VoicePlaceholder.description: Placeholder text shown in the chat input when voice input is available (default: 'Alt+A = mic on/off | Alt+Q = mic off + send').
VoicePlaceholder.descriptionDe: Platzhaltertext im Chat-Eingabefeld, wenn Spracheingabe verfügbar ist (Standard: 'Alt+A = Mikrofon an/aus | Alt+Q = Mikrofon aus + senden').
VoicePlaceholder.descriptionIt: Testo segnaposto mostrato nell'input chat quando l'input vocale è disponibile (predefinito: 'Alt+A = mic on/off | Alt+Q = mic off + invia').

VoiceSendHotkey.description: Keyboard shortcut to stop recording and send, e.g. 'Alt+Q' (default: 'Alt+Q').
VoiceSendHotkey.descriptionDe: Tastenkürzel zum Stoppen der Aufnahme und Senden, z. B. 'Alt+Q' (Standard: 'Alt+Q').
VoiceSendHotkey.descriptionIt: Scorciatoia da tastiera per fermare la registrazione e inviare, es. 'Alt+Q' (predefinito: 'Alt+Q').

Language.description: Language code for Whisper speech-to-text (e.g. 'de', 'en'). Empty or unset means auto-detect.
Language.descriptionDe: Sprachcode für Whisper-Sprach-zu-Text (z. B. 'de', 'en'). Leer bedeutet Auto-Erkennung.
Language.descriptionIt: Codice lingua per Whisper speech-to-text (es. 'de', 'en'). Vuoto o non impostato indica rilevamento automatico.

ResponseLanguage.description: Two-letter ISO 639-1 code (e.g. 'de', 'fr'). When set, the AI is forced to respond in this language.
ResponseLanguage.descriptionDe: Zweistelliger ISO-639-1-Code (z. B. 'de', 'fr'). Wenn gesetzt, wird die KI gezwungen, in dieser Sprache zu antworten.
ResponseLanguage.descriptionIt: Codice ISO 639-1 di due lettere (es. 'de', 'fr'). Se impostato, l'AI è obbligata a rispondere in questa lingua.

Specialist.description: Name of a specialist model registered via an AI_LLAMA_STD_SPECIALIST_XXX plugin property. Routes requests to that specialist's server.
Specialist.descriptionDe: Name eines Spezialistenmodells, das über eine AI_LLAMA_STD_SPECIALIST_XXX-Plugin-Eigenschaft registriert ist. Leitet Anfragen an den Server dieses Spezialisten weiter.
Specialist.descriptionIt: Nome di un modello specialista registrato tramite una proprietà plugin AI_LLAMA_STD_SPECIALIST_XXX. Instrada le richieste al server di quello specialista.

QueueBadge.description: If set to 'true', shows a badge with the current queue position while waiting for inference.
QueueBadge.descriptionDe: Wenn auf 'true' gesetzt, wird während des Wartens auf die Inferenz ein Abzeichen mit der aktuellen Warteschlangenposition angezeigt.
QueueBadge.descriptionIt: Se impostato su 'true', mostra un badge con la posizione corrente in coda mentre si attende l'inferenza.

QueueText.description: Text appended after the queue position number in the badge (e.g. 'in queue' shows '3 in queue'). Default: empty.
QueueText.descriptionDe: Text, der nach der Warteschlangenpositionsnummer im Abzeichen angehängt wird (z. B. 'in Warteschlange' zeigt '3 in Warteschlange'). Standard: leer.
QueueText.descriptionIt: Testo aggiunto dopo il numero di posizione in coda nel badge (es. 'in coda' mostra '3 in coda'). Predefinito: vuoto.

AlertOnFinishText.description: Text shown in the alert when inference finishes (when the alert-on-finish option is enabled).
AlertOnFinishText.descriptionDe: Text, der in der Meldung angezeigt wird, wenn die Inferenz abgeschlossen ist (wenn die Option Meldung-bei-Fertigstellung aktiviert ist).
AlertOnFinishText.descriptionIt: Testo mostrato nell'avviso quando l'inferenza termina (quando l'opzione avviso-al-termine è abilitata).

FilterResults.description: If set to 'true', enables PII filtering on Brave Search queries for this instance.
FilterResults.descriptionDe: Wenn auf 'true' gesetzt, wird die PII-Filterung bei Brave-Search-Abfragen für diese Instanz aktiviert.
FilterResults.descriptionIt: Se impostato su 'true', abilita il filtraggio PII sulle query di Brave Search per questa istanza.
